mission.title: Digital Device
mission.description: Steal a powerful device from a Zion crew.

npc.say: I locked myself in my office when the FBI guys showed up and then all hell broke loose! You're not here to kill me... are you?
You're not one of the Agents?!
You've killed my crew! You'll pay for that!

If you must know what the device does, I can tell you... It's an extension of Disguise Mask that allows a person to carry the signature signal of a Machine program. Basically, all Machine programs would think you are one of them. You could live amongst Agents and they would never question who you are! It's quite amazing.
I'm only saying what I heard.

phase.briefing:
According to my data a group of Machine operatives descended upon one of our operatives who was assigned to steal a powerful device from a group of Zion operatives. Before we lost contact with Rabbit, he reported that the Zion operatives were still on site with the device.
If this is true, we need you to find Rabbit and finish the job if he is unable. Steal the device we seek and ensure that it doesn't fall back into the hands of Zion.

enter.say: The top priority is stealing the device.

done.say: I think you've killed them all.
As Flood suspected, Rabbit is dead. There's no need to pull him out.
I think I know who this is... He's terribly familiar. Do me a favor and check his corpse.

near.say: You're not one of the Agents?!

phase.briefing:
Interesting... Whale was part of Bohrmann's crew. The document that he was carrying has the coordinates of a base of theirs.
I'm sending you to this base to pay Bohrmann a friendly visit. Bohrmann has the device we seek.

enter.say: I doubt they will welcome your intrusion with open arms; unless they're looking forward to beating the crap out of you.

done.say: Try that Key on the wall Safe.
The Signature Manipulator is inside the safe. Take it!

That's the device! With this piece of hardware it will allow Exiles to pose as legitimate programs amongst the Machines; even redpills, such as yourself. They won't be able to tell the difference because it causes the carrier to give off the same signal as a Machine program!

near.say: Merovingian operatives! Don't let them get the device!

phase.briefing:
Before we can make use of the device, we need to have one of our technicians try and decompile its code. If this is possible we can replicate the device and produce one for every Exile and redpill that works for the Merovingian.
Meet with Genaro Kiske. He is our expert on high-level data replication.

talk.say: Flood said I could expect you. Do you have the device? Give it to me!

objective.text: Give the Signature Manipulator to Genaro Kiske

done.say: If you must know what the device does, I can tell you... It's an extension of Disguise Mask that allows a person to carry the signature signal of a Machine program. Basically, all Machine programs would think you are one of them. You could live amongst Agents and they would never question who you are! It's quite amazing.

mission.finish: Once Genaro Kiske has had a chance to try and replicate the device, we will need your assistance again. We'll be in touch.
